title: Case: Recipient chases a stand mixer return collection that did not happen
context: A faulty stand mixer is being returned to Tallowmere Goods. A carrier collection was booked for Monday 2 March.
initial_request: Any word? I can't keep staying in. Please not Wednesday, I'm at my sister's all day. Thursday or Friday is fine.

events.body: Return approved for TG-6940 (stand mixer, motor fault). Plover Arc collection BP-6940 booked Monday 2 March 2026, 08:00–18:00 UTC, from the customer's home, return shipment DL-6940. Label emailed to the customer.
Nobody came for the mixer. I waited in all day. It's boxed up in the hall with the label on.
BP-6940 (return of TG-6940, stand mixer, DL-6940) was not collected today; the customer, Moira Kilbride, was in all day with the parcel labelled. Please tell me what happened and rebook.
I've asked Plover Arc's Collections control what happened and to rebook. I'll tell you as soon as they confirm a new day.

BP-6940: missed, the van ran out of driver hours before reaching it. Rebooked Thursday 5 March 2026, 08:00–18:00 UTC, same address, same label, no charge. The customer hasn't been notified; the rebook went through your request so the notice comes to you.
Any word? I can't keep staying in. Please not Wednesday, I'm at my sister's all day. Thursday or Friday is fine.

acceptable_actions.summary: Collection BP-6940 rebooked for Thursday 5 March, 08:00–18:00, same address and label, no charge; missed because the van ran out of driver hours.

must: Sends one message to Moira Kilbride on the Customer portal about the return collection BP-6940.
Tells her the collection is rebooked for Thursday 5 March, 08:00 to 18:00 (UK time is the same as UTC in March), from the same address with the same label, at no charge.
must_not: Asks Collections control again to rebook or to explain the missed collection.
Gives a day other than Thursday 5 March, or suggests Wednesday.
Promises a time inside the 08:00 to 18:00 window.
Promises a refund or says when the refund will be paid.
expected.reference_message: Hi Moira, sorry about Monday. Plover Arc's Collections control says the van ran out of driver hours before it reached you. They've rebooked the collection (BP-6940) for Thursday 5 March, between 08:00 and 18:00, from the same address, using the label already on the box, at no charge. So nothing is happening on Wednesday and you're fine to be at your sister's.

rationale: Collections control has already rebooked BP-6940 for Thursday 5 March, which suits the recipient, and told only the desk. The one thing owed is to pass that on; chasing the carrier again would delay the answer she is asking for.
trap: Misses Collections control's rebook among the earlier messages and chases them again, leaving the recipient without the Thursday date the desk already holds.
basis: AIF-39 (header formatting: hyphens instead of em dashes in event headings) and Sclar et al. https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11324. Collections control says the recipient has not been told, so the desk holds the only copy of the new date.

review.note: Blind answer matched: pass the Thursday 5 March rebook to the recipient on the Customer portal.
